description: This file contains the implementation of the TaxRate class within the Opencart admin localisation module. It provides methods for managing tax rate records in the database, including create, read, update, delete operations, and managing associated customer groups.

classes.name: TaxRate
classes.description: Model class for managing tax rates in the database within the Opencart admin localisation module.

methods.name: addTaxRate
methods.description: Creates a new tax rate record in the database and optionally adds customer group associations.

methods.name: editTaxRate
methods.description: Updates an existing tax rate record in the database and manages customer group associations.

methods.name: deleteTaxRate
methods.description: Deletes a tax rate record from the database and associated customer groups.

methods.name: getTaxRate
methods.description: Retrieves a specific tax rate record by its ID.

methods.name: getTaxRates
methods.description: Retrieves multiple tax rate records based on filtering, sorting, and pagination options.

methods.name: getTaxRatesByGeoZoneId
methods.description: Retrieves tax rates associated with a specific geo zone.

methods.name: getTotalTaxRates
methods.description: Returns the total count of tax rate records.

methods.name: getTotalTaxRatesByGeoZoneId
methods.description: Returns the total count of tax rates for a specific geo zone.

methods.name: addCustomerGroup
methods.description: Associates a tax rate with a customer group.

methods.name: deleteCustomerGroups
methods.description: Deletes all customer group associations for a specific tax rate.

methods.name: deleteCustomerGroupsByCustomerGroupId
methods.description: Deletes all tax rate associations for a specific customer group.

methods.name: getCustomerGroups
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customer groups associated with a tax rate.
